mapper.select: SELECT id FROM instrument WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_report(instrument_id, period_end, report_type, published_at, available_at, publication_precision, vendor_updated_at, fetched_at, content_hash, source_url, raw_json, version, revenue, net_profit, operating_cashflow, gross_margin, revenue_yoy, profit_yoy, source) SELECT #{id}, #{s.periodEnd}, #{s.reportType}, #{s.publishedAt}, #{s.availableAt}, 'DAY', #{s.vendorUpdatedAt}, #{fetched}, #{s.hash}, #{s.sourceUrl}, #{s.rawJson}, COALESCE(MAX(version), 0)+1, #{s.revenue}, #{s.netProfit}, #{s.operatingCashflow}, #{s.grossMargin}, #{s.revenueYoy}, #{s.profitYoy}, 'EASTMONEY_FREE' FROM financial_report WHERE instrument_id=#{id} AND period_end=#{s.periodEnd} AND report_type=#{s.reportType}
